pass_context.target_description: Consistency of the workflow-server activity and workflow YAML definition grammar — whether like constructs receive like treatment across the language.
pass_context.analysis_focus: Evaluate consistency of the two parallel predicate grammars — 281 string `when:` gates against 109 structured `condition:` trees with no lowering between them, including the verbatim same four-term predicate written both ways in workflow-authoring/activities/09-validate-and-commit.yaml; the undeclared third grammar in actions[].target (38 uses, 22 with operators) competing with 11 actions[].condition trees on the same verb; the reads/writes asymmetry (618 bare strings against 525 four-key objects); and whether constructs appearing at both activity and workflow level are written alike. The run settles a target grammar and specifies it; it does not write grammar/*.ebnf or constraints/*.als.

pass_context.target_description: Expressiveness, Architecture and Feasibility of a shorthand expression grammar for workflow-server activity and workflow YAML.
pass_context.analysis_focus: Expressiveness: what authors are forced to restate — the five-line-versus-one-line cost of `condition` where 75 of 109 are a single leaf and all 86 children restate type: simple; 145 of 410 technique inputs being pure renames with 10 identity passthroughs; `required` populated on 6 of 525 writes entries; the absence of set-membership against the corpus's a == 'x' || a == 'y' chains; and which of the 15 existing sugar precedents transfer to the un-sugared constructs. Architecture: whether `when` should desugar into Condition or stay parallel, given two ASTs, two evaluators, two duplicated path resolvers and a single and-combination meeting point in gate-liveness.ts; placement of the parse boundary given the server never evaluates gates and enforcement lives in scripts/; the four-way single source of truth across Zod, generated JSON Schemas, EBNF and Alloy; loader-level sugar present in neither schema; and whether the settled grammar is expressible in EBNF and constrainable in Alloy at all. Feasibility: `when` being z.string() so no Zod change catches new syntax, which must instead be taught to tokenize/Parser and to scripts/check-when-expression.ts; JSON Schemas generated from Zod with no regeneration or drift check and already stale; technique.schema.json hand-maintained and already drifted; migration touching 109 condition blocks, 211 structured technique bindings and 192 graph edges. The run settles a target grammar and specifies it; it does not write grammar/*.ebnf or constraints/*.als.

definition_gaps: workflow-engine::handle-sub-workflow declares the input parent_session_index with no binding source. The composed signature reports it as UNRESOLVED: no workflow variable, prior step output, or step-binding supplies it, and the trigger-prism step binds only workflow_id. The value is the session's own index, so either the signature needs a declared default or the step needs an explicit binding.
